title.en: An Act to Authorize the Director of Mines to Enter into an Operating Contract, with the Approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, with Private Enterprise for the Development, Exploration, Processing and Disposition of the Minerals in the Government Mineral Reservation at the Municipalities of Masinloc and Candelaria, Province of Zambales, and for Other Purposes

text.en: Recognizing the importance to the national economy of the immediate development, exploration, utilization, processing and disposition by private enterprise of the mineral deposits in the Zambales Mineral Reservations, it is hereby declared to be the policy of the Government to engage private enterprise in the development, exploration, processing and disposition of the minerals therefrom.

The Director of Mines is hereby authorized to enter into an operating contract, through public bidding, with any qualified, competent and responsible domestic party or parties possessing all the qualifications under section three hereof, for the development and operation of the government chromite reservations described and known as Parcel of Land numbers one, two and three thereof, set aside as such by Proclamation Numbered Three hundred thirteen dated April twenty-four, nineteen hundred and thirty of the then Governor General of the Philippine Islands, such contract to be executed by the Director of Mines with the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources.

The Director of Mines shall have the power and authority to represent the Government in such operation and to ensure compliance with the terms and conditions of the operating contract, and for this purpose, he is hereby authorized to set aside five percent (5%) of the royalties or participation received by the Government under the contract to cover necessary expenses of his office in connection therewith.
All laws and regulations inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby accordingly amended or repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1959.
